records.subject: Confirming cancellation for Ridge Studio
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Confirming the cancellation on our end. We're sorry Wrenfield didn't end up being the right fit for Ridge Studio -- the door's open if that changes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have Ridge Studio here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone despite welcome, nudge, check-in (email:6dd41106, email:e7fa1977, email:9f90361a) and a held kickoff (calendar:dd3e0764) with zero customer replies or tickets. Silence after a live kickoff suggests low internal priority; 8 days left but no momentum signal.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on with nudges, so this is my last one for a while.

The usual first step is getting one real project in, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm glad to set up a short call this week and get that first project started with you.

Best,
Nadia
